# Security

Report a vulnerability privately through [GitHub's advisory form](https://github.com/michael-denyer/agent-formal-verify/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for it.

Include the affected version, the verification helper or plugin involved, and the impact you observed. A minimal example using dummy data helps the maintainer investigate.

Use the private advisory to discuss a fix and agree on a disclosure date with the maintainer before publishing details.

Only the latest release receives fixes. Plugin installs update by version number, so a fix ships as a new release, and there are no release branches to back-port to.
